prompt: A photorealistic head-and-shoulders frame taken by the built-in lens at the top edge of a laptop screen, looking slightly up at a home-office desk. Giles sits centred and a little low in the frame, his brows drawn very slightly together, his eyelids narrowed and his lips pressed flat, his eyes aimed down at something below the lens; one hand holds a fork stopped in the air a short distance from his mouth with a green forkful of salad on it. Behind him a tall bookcase of mismatched hardbacks, a framed print and a lamp fill the wall; the book spines are soft and unreadable. Cold white daylight pours from a window out of frame on the right and blows out part of the wall, while the face falls into dull flat shadow on the left. Washed-out colour, soft focus, a visibly compressed video-call picture with smeared skin detail. A takeaway salad tub sits on the desk edge. No writing anywhere. Thanks.
